#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>

long long dfs(long long repunits[], long long n, int idx) {
    long long quot = n / repunits[idx];
    long long rem = n % repunits[idx];
    long long used = quot * idx;
    if (rem == 0) return used;
    else return used + std::min(dfs(repunits, rem, idx - 1),
                                idx + dfs(repunits, repunits[idx] - rem, idx - 1));
}

int main() {
    long long n;
    std::cin >> n;
    long long repunits[17] = {0};
    for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
        repunits[i] = 10 * repunits[i - 1] + 1;
    }
    long long result = dfs(repunits, n, 16);
    std::cout << result << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
